critical_code_review_comments: search_router builds four separate Mongo queries sequentially with `async for`. For low limit (6) this is fine but consider asyncio.gather over the four cursors to parallelize IO under load.
SearchPalette debounce is 180ms in code (docstring said 500-700ms). Ensure product/UX agreed on 180ms — feels snappy but on slow networks may fire mid-typing bursts. Not a bug.

WiringGenerator's ?fork=<token> effect reuses /wiring/share/{token} via the shared axios instance which sends Authorization if present — the public endpoint ignores auth, so authed users work fine. For anonymous users, SharedWiring already redirects to /register via localStorage.hrl_after_login before hitting ?fork — verified path is safe.

Wokwi label swap works via ternary on `code`. Note: hydrating from ?template=<slug> in Workspace.jsx (lines 82-89) does NOT setCode — only prompt/board/language/projectName. So the label only swaps after Generate or manual typing. This matches product intent (templates are seeds, not code) but could confuse users expecting a template to include starter code.

SharedWiring.jsx forkIt() reads localStorage.hrl_token to decide anon vs authed. If the token is expired but present, forkIt() will still navigate to /app/wiring?fork=..., then the axios interceptor 401s; UX could be improved by validating token freshness first (or letting the shared endpoint being public save us — which it does).

Global search palette does not surface a keyboard hint for opening it (Cmd+K badge is inside the trigger label; good). The palette itself has no explicit ESC handler; relies on Radix Dialog. Works via Radix out of the box — verified Escape closes.
Templates page (Templates.jsx) uses data-testid=`template-<slug>` (not `template-card-<slug>` as one might guess) — no bug, just a documentation callout for next testing agents.

rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found in iteration 4. One informational RCA: the 'Wokwi label swap when code present' verification could not be automated via ?template=<slug> because Workspace.jsx template-hydration path does not call setCode (it only sets prompt/board/language). The SimulatePanel.jsx ternary `{code ? 'Launch in Wokwi with code' : 'Open empty Wokwi playground'}` is deterministic and code-inspected as correct; the 'no code' branch was UI-verified. If the main agent wants automatic verification, extend template loading to hydrate a starter code snippet (optional) or expose a data-testid on the label text so a Monaco-typed state can be asserted without depending on Wokwi copy toast.
